02Forge a new path
Knowledge, not guesswork.
You get more than data with Claims Intelligence — knowledge backed by AI trained to analyze claims, not predict outcomes.
01Focus on facts
Trained to analyze, not predict.
AI trained to read and reason over the claim file — grounded in what the file actually says, not a guess at what happens next.
02Powerful AI
Built to take the weight.
It reads large files, summarizes complex data, and automates repetitive work — freeing staff from dated, manual processes.
03Transform insurance
A more human way forward.
Better claims outcomes for your team, and a new, human-centric way forward for insurance.
03Human-centric solutions
Equip your claims teams with intelligence that actually means something.
Accountable AI
Audit logs, feedback loops, and transparent logic embolden staff to make responsible claims decisions.
Effective AI
Accurate, efficient results that lift the bottom line for insurers.
Ethical AI
Bias-free insights that promote compliant and fair outcomes for every claim.
04Knowledge is the key
Not all claims data is created equal.
Unburden your team.
Knowledge backed by AI — with ethical accountability — frees claims teams from tedious, risk-prone work.
Empower knowledge workers.
AI should uplift people, not replace them. With precise, accountable data, knowledge workers can actually use knowledge — and make insurance more human.

The Claims Intelligence toolkit.
